output_failure_specimens.name: closed-output-apply
output_failure_specimens.stderr_utf8: Error: The pipe is being closed. (os error 232)
output_failure_specimens.induction: Actual subprocess stdout read-end closed before dispatch; no complete report was observed. This is not a captured producer JSON report.

before_fix_windows_boundary.basis: Separately retained before-fix preparation observation. No apply ran. This is not a current-source successful admission or a replay during this capture.

limitations: Selected-format/missing-media/concurrency/in-process activation/readback/prefix fault controls remain separately attributed to tests. The closed-output specimen is actual CLI pipe failure, not a JSON report, network loss or USB test. Desired-state status proves neither historical publisher identity nor runtime/native readiness.
capture_resume_basis: Initial partial capture stopped on an exact owned lock-file inventory read before busy dispatch. Original stdout/stdin bytes are reused and hashed without replay; original executable digest was computed but not durably persisted before that diagnostic. No product rebuild or code change occurred. Digest is durably sampled before resumed commands and at capture end. Per-case inventory recipe distinguishes initial raw lock bytes from resumed exact-owned-lock length normalization.
